callouts.label: Post
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents post.
callouts.description: A post can be copied, interpreted, and seen beyond its intended moment.
callouts.ap_tip: Pause before sharing. Remove private details and get permission for other people’s images.

callouts.label: Comment
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents comment.
callouts.description: Comments contribute to a lasting social and data trail.
callouts.ap_tip: Tone can be misread. Repair harm rather than piling on.

callouts.label: Like and React
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents like and react.
callouts.description: Reactions can signal approval and shape what systems show next.
callouts.ap_tip: A quick tap still communicates. Avoid rewarding harmful content.

callouts.label: Location Clues
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents location clues.
callouts.description: Photos and settings can reveal routines or location even without a location tag.
callouts.ap_tip: Check backgrounds and metadata. Share plans only with appropriate people.

callouts.label: Copied Screenshots
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents copied screenshots.
callouts.description: Deleted content may survive as screenshots or downloads.
callouts.ap_tip: Do not rely on deletion as the only safety plan. Preserve evidence without resharing harmful content.

callouts.label: Expanded Audience
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents expanded audience.
callouts.description: Friends can forward content to audiences you did not choose.
callouts.ap_tip: Privacy settings reduce but do not eliminate risk. Assume the audience may grow.

callouts.label: Data and Algorithms
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents data and algorithms.
callouts.description: Platforms may use behavior to predict interests and shape recommendations.
callouts.ap_tip: Algorithms have goals and blind spots. Attention is part of the exchange.

callouts.label: Future Context
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents future context.
callouts.description: A post may be interpreted differently later or by a new audience.
callouts.ap_tip: Context can disappear. A digital mistake does not define a person forever.

callouts.label: Privacy and Reporting
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents privacy and reporting.
callouts.description: Use privacy, blocking, and reporting controls intentionally.
callouts.ap_tip: Review settings after updates. Platform tools may need adult or school follow-up.

callouts.label: Trusted Support
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents trusted support.
callouts.description: Tell a trusted adult when contact, threats, exploitation, or content feels unsafe.
callouts.ap_tip: Keep evidence when safe. Urgent threats require immediate help.
